what: a wood shovel: a rounded, slightly pointed spade blade of carved warm orange-brown wood with clear grain, crude and chunky at the handle's top end, the blade lying along the same diagonal as the handle and its rounded tip pointing to the top-right, a plain wooden handle, the head lashed on with tan cord, the handle running from the bottom-left corner up toward the top-right.
